mapper.insert: INSERT INTO m_subject ( jky_subject_id, subject_code, subject_name, subject_short_name, tax_identify_number, is_delete, source_created_time, source_modified_time, last_sync_time, created_time, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{jkySubjectId}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, #{subjectShortName}, #{taxIdentifyNumber}, #{isDelete}, #{sourceCreatedTime}, #{sourceModifiedTime}, #{lastSyncTime}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE subject_code = VALUES(subject_code), subject_name = VALUES(subject_name), subject_short_name = VALUES(subject_short_name), tax_identify_number = VALUES(tax_identify_number), is_delete = VALUES(is_delete), source_created_time = VALUES(source_created_time), source_modified_time = VALUES(source_modified_time), last_sync_time = VALUES(last_sync_time), updated_time = VALUES(updated_time)
